name: verifiers
summary: Prime Intellect’s MIT library for creating LLM reinforcement-learning environments and evals, with a matching PyPI package.
description: Established Prime Intellect project (canonical repo PrimeIntellect-ai/verifiers; not archived; created 2025-01-22; willccbb/verifiers currently redirects here). Not presented as a brand-new 2026 launch. Root LICENSE is MIT (Copyright 2026 Prime Intellect). PyPI verifiers 0.4.1 verified 2026-11-12 (not yanked; wheel uploaded 2026-11-03; project URLs point at this repository). README describes it as a library for creating environments to train and evaluate LLMs, tightly integrated with Prime Intellect’s Environments Hub, the prime-rl trainer, and a Hosted Training platform. The Environments Hub and Hosted Training are Prime Intellect products (https://app.primeintellect.ai/…); they may require accounts and can incur real compute cost — no signup or spending was done. Environments can execute task or agent code. Repo docs/ and AGENTS.md are in-tree guides; no separate docs hostname was used. Same operator family as prime-rl.

agent_access.notes: Python package: verifiers 0.4.1 on PyPI. Hosted Prime Intellect Environments Hub / training dashboards were not signed into.
